crossRefs.note: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever.
Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.
I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you…
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow…
Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good…
The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I…
However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example…

translations.web: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
translations.bsb: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
translations.kjv: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
translations.asv: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah: The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.
